data.title: 红月卡莲 · 清凉夜风中的依偎坦诚
data.description: 静谧高楼露台上，卡莲身穿真丝吊带背心倚靠着扶手，城市万家灯火在脚下流淌，回过头时双颊微红，流露出褪去防备后的依赖与深情。
data.action: resting against railing, looking back, gentle blush, soft eyes
data.lighting: soft balcony ambient lights and distant glittering city skyline
data.promptProse: On a quiet high-rise balcony overlooking the glittering night city, Kallen Kouzuki turns with a gentle blush and tender, unguarded eyes in a crimson camisole.
data.animaCaption: Kallen blushing softly on a quiet balcony overlooking city lights.
